Several weeks (the missions depend on the stage of the Deeplings world change)

The scientist {npc:Spectulus} discovered a strange island and a giant staircase leading to a world beneath the sea. Follow his notes to {wiki:Gray Beach}, enter {wiki:Fiehonja|Fiehonja} and take part in the missions of the Deeplings world change: sea hearts for the god-king Qjell, purification of Deepling Spawns, coral mines and the Deepling Guardian bosses. You earn the {wiki:Deepling Outfits|Deepling Outfits} with both addons, access to the deepest zones of Fiehonja, random prizes and several achievements.
In part 1 (*The First Visitor*), when {npc:Spectulus} gives you the upgrades to walk underwater.
In section 2, when you first enter the staircase teleport at the end of the shortcut path.
The Gray Beach teleport now takes you to the protected area next to the Qjell statue.
In stage 3 of the Deeplings world change, when the coral ramp is built.
Stage 2: after mining and handing in 10 boxes of {item:Fossilised Coral} at the Coral Mine.
Stage 3 only; access to 1 boss and 1 prize chest per rotation.
